intro: Please read these terms before creating or using a PaliTrento account.

sections.title: 1. Using PaliTrento
sections.body: By creating an account or using PaliTrento, you agree to these terms. PaliTrento provides tools to discover local stores, view product and price information, save favorites, and communicate with participating businesses. Features may change as the service develops.

sections.title: 2. Your account
sections.body: Provide accurate registration information and keep your login credentials secure. You are responsible for activity under your account. Notify the PaliTrento team if you believe your account has been accessed without your permission. You must be legally able to enter into this agreement to register.

sections.title: 3. Customers and business owners
sections.body: Customers should use listings and price information as a guide and confirm availability, prices, and conditions directly with the store. Business owners are responsible for the accuracy, legality, and timely updating of the store, product, price, and contact information they submit. PaliTrento may review, correct, or remove content that is inaccurate or violates these terms.

sections.title: 4. Acceptable use
sections.body: Do not misuse the service, interfere with its operation, attempt unauthorized access, submit fraudulent or misleading content, infringe another person's rights, or use PaliTrento for unlawful activity. We may restrict or suspend accounts that violate these terms or put users or the service at risk.

sections.title: 5. Privacy
sections.body: PaliTrento uses the information you provide to operate your account, verify your email, provide requested features, and maintain the service. Account and profile information may be visible to others where a feature or your settings allow it. Do not submit information you do not have the right to share. You can manage available privacy preferences in your account settings.

sections.title: 6. Service information and availability
sections.body: Store listings, prices, and other information are provided by users or participating businesses and may not always be current or complete. PaliTrento is provided on an availability basis; we may maintain, update, or temporarily suspend parts of the service.

sections.title: 7. Changes and contact
sections.body: We may update these terms as the service changes. The current version will be available on this page. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised terms. For questions about these terms, contact the PaliTrento team through the contact information provided on the website.
